title: OOBB precision screwdriver
summary: A printable, bearing-capped handle for long quarter-inch hex bits. Choose the handle by the round shaft diameter and the cap by the drive marking.
parts: Print one handle plate and one cap. Each handle plate contains the body, slotted key, side-loading nut cradle, bearing lifter and countersunk insert.
assembly: Load the bit and lock before fitting the cradle, lifter and bearing. The cap presses onto the outer ring.
credit: The Oomlout precision screwdriver is the starting design. Wera Kraftform Micro and the iFixit Precision Bit Driver informed the fingertip waist and grip texture.

study.observation: Wera divides the handle into a precision zone near the tip, a wider torque grip and a fast-turning zone near the cap.
study.decision: Give the fingertips a 10.3 mm waist, increase the thumb pad to 12.7 mm, and keep the rear taper smooth for spinning.

study.observation: The 115 mm aluminium driver combines a knurled grip with a swivel cap.
study.decision: Use eight broad axial flutes on the thumb pad. Their tapered ends follow the print direction and leave the adjacent spanner flats accessible.

study.observation: Wiha puts the drive symbol on its rotating end cap so a driver can be identified in the rack.
study.decision: Pair the printed drive symbol with its size on the closed cap face. Torx caps carry a T prefix and a rounded six-lobe mark.

archive_versions.title: Version 2
archive_versions.description: First 606 bearing assembly, 111.6 mm nose to palm

version_description: 101.6 mm capped, waisted grip and Torx labels

book.materials: One handle plate, one cap, one 100 mm quarter-inch bit, one 606 bearing (6 × 17 × 6 mm), two M3 nuts, and M3 × 6 mm and M3 × 16 mm countersunk screws.

steps.title: Lock the bit
steps.action: Feed the bit tip-first from the rear. Slide in the key, align its slot, and secure it with the side nut and M3 × 6 mm screw.

steps.title: Load the cradle
steps.action: Slide the second M3 nut edge-first into the cradle, thread facing up. Push the cradle into the side slot until its curved face is flush.

steps.title: Seat the bearing
steps.action: Seat the lifter in the handle. Place the 606 on its raised centre, then fit the insert into the bearing bore, countersink facing up.

steps.title: Fit the cap
steps.action: Tighten the M3 × 16 mm screw into the captive nut. Check the outer ring spins, press the cap onto it, and spin again under light pressure.
